domain_setting: A home workshop opening onto a small garden, with a shared warm timber work surface and clear outdoor planting beds.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 card with critical shapes inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Workshop bench or garden soil line near y=145
Hand tool handles are thick enough to read at a 152x96 thumbnail
A small adult hand may establish scale for tools without becoming the focal subject
Garden scenes use the same warm timber and muted botanical greens as the workshop scenes

polysemy_resolution_table.level: The adjective meaning flat or horizontal; the measuring instrument is shown separately as spirit level.
polysemy_resolution_table.nail / nails (plural): Metal fasteners with smooth shafts and pointed ends, despite the Japanese fingernail gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.nuts: Hardware nuts that fit bolts, despite the Japanese gloss meaning crazy.
polysemy_resolution_table.plane: A woodworking hand plane used to smooth a board, not a flat surface or aircraft.
polysemy_resolution_table.saw: A hand saw used to cut wood, not the past tense of see.
polysemy_resolution_table.wrench: A hand tool for gripping and turning a fastener, inferred from the hand-tools group despite the verb-oriented Japanese gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.vise / vice (UK spelling): A bench-mounted clamp that holds a workpiece; exclude the unrelated meaning of vice.
polysemy_resolution_table.fork (gardening): A long-handled garden fork used to loosen soil, not eating cutlery.
polysemy_resolution_table.hose: A flexible watering hose, despite the Japanese hosiery gloss; distinguish its use from the isolated garden hose.
polysemy_resolution_table.trowel: A small garden hand trowel for planting in soil, guided by the gardening group despite the masonry-oriented Japanese gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.shape: The form or outline of a finished object in the home-repair group; show a visible contour being formed, not physical fitness.

contrast_notes.allen keys / hex keys: Allen keys are a set held together in a folding holder; hex keys show one L-shaped key engaging a socket fastener.
contrast_notes.level / spirit level: Level is the adjective shown by a level shelf compared with a tilted reference; spirit level is the bubble instrument.
contrast_notes.tape measure / measuring tape: Tape measure is the retractable case with a rigid metal blade; measuring tape is a flexible strip bending around an object.
contrast_notes.screw / nail / bolt / nuts: Screw has a threaded shaft and slotted head; nail has a smooth shaft and point; bolt has a blunt threaded shaft and head; nuts are hexagonal fasteners around a bolt.
contrast_notes.monkey wrench / wrench: Monkey wrench has an obvious adjustable jaw; wrench is shown as a fixed open-ended spanner gripping a nut.
contrast_notes.garden hose / hose: Garden hose is an isolated coiled hose connected to a tap; hose shows a person watering plants with a stream from the nozzle.
contrast_notes.hoe / rake / garden fork / shovel / trow: Each tool has a distinct head and scale: hoe blade, rake teeth, garden fork tines, broad shovel, and small hand trowel.
contrast_notes.lawn mower / mow the lawn: Lawn mower isolates the machine; mow the lawn shows a person pushing it and a clear cut/uncut grass boundary.
contrast_notes.prune trees / trim a hedge: Prune trees uses long-handled loppers on a tree branch; trim a hedge uses shears shaping a hedge face.
contrast_notes.paint / paintbrush / roller (paint) / pa: Paint is a can of coating; paintbrush and roller isolate distinct applicators; room painting is an interior wall action; house painting is an exterior action.
contrast_notes.unblock the sink / unclog the sink: Unblock emphasizes removing a solid obstruction with a hand tool; unclog emphasizes water draining after a plunger clears the pipe.
